questions.text: A disc makes 1200 revolutions per minute. Find its rotation frequency (1/s).

Find the angular velocity of a body with a rotation period of 0.785 s (rad/s).
Find the maximum angular velocity of a flywheel with a rotation frequency of 0.0796 s⁻¹ (rad/s).

Which of the following expresses a time interval of 12·10³ seconds?
